review:
John Hunter in the Mayan jungle, on a 5x3, 10-line grid. The base game is simple; the main event is the progressive free spins.

As you move up levels in the bonus, you get more spins and bigger multipliers, so the round builds momentum the longer it lasts. 96.46% RTP. Simple and focused – one escalating bonus rather than lots of random features.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
